disclosures.text: If you want to arrange a direct cremation, you can use an alternative container. Alternative containers encase the body and can be made of materials like fiberboard or composition materials (with or without an outside covering). The containers we provide are a fiberboard container or an unfinished wood box.

items.label: Receiving Remains from Another Funeral Home
items.includesText: Our charge includes: basic services of funeral director and staff; a proportionate share of overhead costs; care of remains; transportation of remains to funeral home and to cemetery or crematory.

items.label: Direct Cremation
items.includesText: Our charge for a direct cremation (without ceremony) includes: basic services of funeral director and staff; a proportionate share of overhead costs; removal of remains; transportation to crematory; necessary authorizations and cremation.

items.label: A. Direct cremation with container provided by the purchaser
B. Direct cremation with a fiberboard container
C. Direct cremation with an unfinished wood box
Immediate Burial
items.includesText: Our charge for an immediate burial (without ceremony) includes: basic services of funeral director and staff; a proportionate share of overhead costs; removal of remains; and local transportation to cemetery.

items.label: A. Immediate burial with casket provided by the purchaser
B. Immediate burial with a cloth-covered wood casket
